## Summary

Describe the user-visible or operational outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm audit --prod`
- [ ] `pnpm licenses:check`
- [ ] Compose configuration checked, or reason documented

## Monitoring and security invariants

- [ ] Sponsored cards remain exclusion-only; no advertising-rank fields were added.
- [ ] `暂无` / `未完成` semantics remain evidence-based.
- [ ] CAPTCHA still stops remaining work; no bypass/evasion behavior was added.
- [ ] No secrets, real customer ASIN lists, personal metadata, or production URLs are included.
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation are updated when needed.
